yet, however: Jhn.4:27, al.; εἰ μ., Jas.2:8 (if indeed).

elsewhere.note: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from…
However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
